CONTENT.BACKGROUND_APPRENTICE: My apprenticeship involved leading the design, development and operation of a software automation application for enhancing the management of student registration and counseling. This experience made me focus on studying to become a software engineer.
CONTENT.BACKGROUND_BROEN: Previously, I've had the pleasure of applying software solutions to accelerate the adoption of Industry 4.0 and Internet of Things. Being responsible for creating a functional prototype for a cloud connected industry valve to improve monitoring and fault-detection in water, district heating and gas infrastructure.
CONTENT.BACKGROUND_EDUCATION: Before being able to gain admittance to an university, I had to graduate from an upper secondary education. To fast track this process, an educational program was personalized for me to complete a two-year education within 11 months.
CONTENT.BACKGROUND_UR: I have experience with various software development positions and projects. I'm currently empowering the development and maintenance of interactive software for the worlds leading collaborative robotics company. Attributing to a renewed longevity and resolving accumulated technical debt for improved development velocity.
CONTENT.INTRO: A young software engineer located in Odense, Denmark. I have an Master in Software Engineering from the University of Southern Denmark. I value creating software solutions where efficient development means balancing velocity, quality and longevity.
CONTENT.OUTRO: I graduated as a MSc in Software Engineering in 2023, and have since grown in my current position at Universal Robots A/S to be responsible for the user interface of PolyScope 5. If you are still curious, or think I could be someone you need, then let's have a chat.

APPRENTICE_ROLE.DESCRIPTION: Responsible for the development of software for internal usage, focusing on improving the processes of student intake and counseling within the vocational institution. Point of contact for domain users. Web and database development with server deployment.

BROEN.DESCRIPTION: Contributed to a pilot project exploring Industry 4.0 and Internet of Things (IoT) through the development of a cyber-physical system. Focused on prototyping, connectivity, and cloud infrastructure to enable real-time industrial automation solutions.
BROEN.DESCRIPTION_EXTENDED: Developed and prototyped an embedded platform supporting Industry 4.0 applications, focusing on system architecture and functionality. Designed and implemented IoT connectivity solutions using NB-IoT to ensure reliable data transmission for industrial sensors. Additionally, built and optimized cloud-based data processing and storage systems, leveraging Microsoft Azure to enhance scalability and efficiency.

UR_FULL.DESCRIPTION: Versatile software engineer leading the technical development of PolyScope 5, driving business-critical advancements for major accounts and ensuring reliability across 100,000+ deployed robots.
UR_FULL.DESCRIPTION_EXTENDED: Full-stack development on the next-generation PolyScope X platform, focusing on team planning and execution to uphold a reputation of highest quality, integrity, and transparency.
UR_FULL.LI_1: Led team of 5 developers, managing technical strategies, sprint planning, and collaboration with key accounts.
UR_FULL.LI_2: Delivered 8 on-target and in-scope software releases in a row.
UR_FULL.LI_3: Designed and implemented multi-stacked architectures using Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Angular, Docker, and Quarkus.
UR_FULL.LI_4: Co-developed public APIs, improving integration accessibility for users and third-party developers.
UR_FULL.LI_5: Produced technical evidence for intellectual property injunctions.
UR_FULL.LI_6: Provided 3rd-line support for major clients, including on-site engineering visits.

UR_PART_1.DESCRIPTION: Contributing to the development and optimization of PolyScope 5, the control and programming interface empowering Universal Robots' collaborative robots. Worked closely with the team to enhance software architecture, reduce technical debt, and introduce new functionality, ensuring seamless operation and integration for industrial automation.
UR_PART_1.DESCRIPTION_EXTENDED: Optimized software architecture to improve adaptability and efficiency while reducing technical debt. Led dependency migrations with Maven and enhanced third-party integrations using OSGi. Developed UI functionality in Swing, refined CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, and collaborated in debugging to ensure reliability.
